summary.zh: 把内容拆成适合社交平台传播的图卡
summary.en: Turn content into shareable social image cards

description.zh: 把一段内容拆成 1 到 10 张卡通风格图片卡片，提供 12 种视觉风格、8 种版式和 3 套配色可选。适合小红书种草、微信图文这类需要连续多图呈现的场景。生成图片需要可用的图像生成后端。
description.en: Breaks a piece of writing into 1 to 10 cartoon-style cards, with 12 visual styles, 8 layouts and 3 palettes to choose from. Built for Xiaohongshu and WeChat posts that need a scrollable card series. An image generation backend is required.
